designs.identity: 原創成年男性斥候；深灰兜帽、藍綠領巾、輕皮甲、短披肩與右手單匕首。

prompts.down: Create ONE original production-ready dark fantasy RPG character ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET for 渡鴉・瑞克, a male adult human scout age about 28. Fully original character: lean athletic adult proportions, charcoal hood, weathered graphite leather armor with muted petrol-teal scarf, short split raven-black shoulder cape ending above knees, dark fitted trousers, sturdy brown-black boots, brown utility belt and tiny brass fasteners. Face visible under hood, short dark stubble, alert silver-gray eyes, no mask. ONE short steel dagger held in anatomical right hand, left hand empty, small folded map pouch at belt. No bow, no shield, no wings. Premium detailed hand-painted semi-realistic 3D game sprite, elevated 3/4 camera looking down at head and shoulders, readable compact silhouette, muted metal highlights. EXACT layout FOUR EQUAL COLUMNS x THREE EQUAL ROWS, 12 separated full-body poses of exactly the SAME scout, all facing SOUTH toward the viewer in the SAME elevated camera. Row 1: four truly different walk cycle poses (left stride, passing, right stride, opposite passing). Row 2: four sequential DAGGER attack poses (windup, draw arm back, diagonal slash, recovery). Row 3 columns 1-2: two skill poses (left hand lifts a small teal signal rune, then extends it, restrained tiny teal light close to hand); row 3 columns 3-4: two hit poses (recoil with bent knees, recovery). Each of 12 cells contains ONE complete person, consistent adult body scale and identical costume and weapons. No duplicate frames; genuine limb motion. Keep all daggers, capes, heads and feet inside individual equal cells with at least 12% transparent margins. Consistent planted foot baseline, clear space between figures. No text, labels, panels, grid lines, scenery, floor, cast shadow, pedestal, huge effects, logos or watermark. Transparent RGBA background, preserve transparent gutters. Wide landscape sprite sheet, high detail.
prompts.right: Use the supplied scout sprite sheet as the character identity and costume reference. Create a new consistent animation sheet of that EXACT same original adult male scout 渡鴉・瑞克: same charcoal hood, petrol teal scarf, graphite leather light armor, short raven cape, belt pouches, boots and SINGLE steel dagger in anatomical RIGHT hand. Premium semi-realistic hand-painted 3D dark fantasy game sprite. Keep elevated 3/4 game camera, body proportions, adult face and all costume details. EXACTLY FOUR EQUAL COLUMNS by THREE EQUAL ROWS, TWELVE separated full-body figures. Row1 four different full walk-cycle phases; row2 four dagger attack phases windup/preparation/slash/recovery; row3 first2 frames left hand teal signal-rune skill gesture, last2 frames hit recoil/recovery. Real articulated limb motion, not translated duplicates. Generous 14% fully transparent margin on EVERY edge of each cell. Make each body slightly SMALLER in its cell than reference to prevent clipping. Complete hood, feet, dagger and cape fully inside EACH cell. No overlaps between cells. All poses use same character scale and camera, consistent ground contact. TRANSPARENT RGBA canvas, no floor/shadows/gradient backdrop, no grid, text, watermark or scenery. DIRECTION: ALL TWELVE figures face SCREEN RIGHT/EAST in true right-facing side or rear-quarter profile, including attack and hit frames. Nose and toes point RIGHT. DO NOT include any frontal or left-facing figures. Dagger stays in right hand in every frame.
